issues.title: Optional websockets dependency is unavailable
issues.workaround: Install the channel optional dependency only when that channel suite is intentionally required.
issues.first_known_evidence: Confirmed by importlib preflight on Windows/Python 3.14.6; the test imports websockets.exceptions at collection time.

issues.title: Historical semantic campaign imports POSIX fcntl
issues.workaround: Run these historical semantic campaign tests on POSIX; do not retry their Windows collection.
issues.first_known_evidence: benchmarks/picobench/semantic_campaign.py imports fcntl at module import time; both listed tests import that module.

issues.title: Long pytest temporary paths can exceed Windows path limits
issues.signature: Windows path or temporary-artifact operation fails under a long pytest base temp
issues.workaround: The canonical runner selects <repo>/.tmp/pytest/<tier>-<pid> before the first pytest launch.
issues.first_known_evidence: Observed during P1B/P1C Windows regression runs; limited to pytest temporary artifacts.

issues.title: Two P0 event-field assertions omit established turn_id
issues.signature: Exact dataclass field-set assertions omit TurnFailed.turn_id and TurnEnded.turn_id
issues.workaround: Deselect only these exact stale nodes; keep the rest of test_spine_events.py active.
issues.first_known_evidence: Assertions predate commit 5c98c0d, which intentionally added Runtime-owned turn_id to lifecycle events without updating these two exact field-set assertions.
